podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

members.name: Twin sister of Kim Deal (11 minutes older)

podcast.title: Career Transition to Professional Knitting
podcast.body: After a career that included success with The Breeders and other bands, Kelly Deal transitioned to become a professional knitter, specializing in handbags, and has even released a book of patterns. "These days, she's a professional knitter, especially as handbags. She's even released a book of patterns."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Defense Contractor Career
podcast.body: Before joining The Breeders, Kelly held a job with a defense contractor, which included having a top-secret clearance. "By the time the breeders came along, Kelly had a job with a defense contractor complete with a top secret clearance."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early Drumming and Pixies Opportunity
podcast.body: Kelly Deal began playing drums at age eight and was nearly recruited to join the Pixies as their drummer alongside her sister. However, after spending time with the band, she concluded she "just didn't have the chops." "She was originally a drummer from the age of eight, and at one point she was almost drafted in to join the Pixies with her sister as the band's drummer, but after hanging out with them, she realized that she just didn't have the chops."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Identical Twin and Untrained Guitarist
podcast.body: Kelly Deal is the identical twin sister of Kim Deal, the original bassist for the Pixies. In 1992, Kelly joined Kim in The Breeders as the guitarist, despite having no prior experience playing the instrument, quickly learning and mastering it. "She was the guitarist. And to be honest, she knew nothing about the instrument. She did not know how to play, but she was a fast learner and nailed it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Late Start on Guitar
podcast.body: She started playing the guitar for the first time at the age of 30, convinced by her sister Kim to join The Breeders. "So she started playing the guitar for the first time at age 30."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Kelly Deal's Legal Troubles
xref.body: Kelly Deal, Kim's sister and band member, faced legal issues when she was caught accepting a FedEx package containing heroin, which took several years to resolve. "But then Kelly got busted when she accepted a FedEx package full of heroin and that took a couple of years to sort out."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Reunions: Some Lasted....and Sadly, Some Didn't ｜ Part 2

xref.title: Kim Deal's Side Project
xref.body: The Breeders originated as Kim Deal's side project while she was still a member of The Pixies. After The Pixies' breakup, she developed it into a full-time band with her sister, Kelly Deal. "Kim Deel remade the breeders, her Pixies side project, into a full-time thing with her sister Kelly."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Reunions: Some Lasted....and Sadly, Some Didn't ｜ Part 2

xref.title: Knitting Hobby and Online Store
xref.body: Kelly Deal is proficient at knitting and operates an online store where she sells unique, handmade scarves. These scarves, which are either knitted or crafted from recycled felt and wool sweaters, are one-of-a-kind, signed by her, and typically retail for around $100 each. "all are one of a kind hand made by her and signed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Touring with Nirvana
xref.body: A year after Kelly Deal started playing guitar, The Breeders embarked on a tour with Nirvana, highlighting their rapid rise in the music scene. "A year later, the breeders were off touring with Nirvana."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
